title: The Magician's Nephew
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: Two children in Victorian London are tricked into using magic rings that carry them between worlds. Their travels bring them to a dying world and to the moment a new one, Narnia, is sung into being.
readIf: you want the origin story of Narnia, full of curious worlds and a sense of wonder.
skipIf: you plan to read the series in publication order, as it spoils some mysteries from the others.

pairings.reason: A larger and stranger children's tale about a world held together by imagination.
Another classic where a child steps into a world with its own odd rules and dreamlike logic.
A comparable early fantasy about children in a magical land, with a lighter and more direct story.
